text: You have to pay for almost every service.
author: Mila Blancquaert
developer_reply: Hi, most features in our app are available for free, as it's quite important for us for the free version of the app to be just as useful. You can close the paywall using the "X" button on top and proceed to use the app for free. Hope this helps!

author: P ‘Layla’ T
developer_reply: We are truly dedicated to delivering the most useful skincare functionality, listening to feedback & requested features and working non-stop on improving the app. We also try our best to balance free and PRO features, as any proceeds we make are put right into further app development and maintenance - we truly appreciate any support we receive <3

text: It's not that great. I was hoping that the app was clear and clean. With lots of ingredients information and recommendations. I asked if they can delete my account.
author: Jamie Leijnse
developer_reply: We released an update with a possibility to create & activate multiple routines (exercise, haircare..), edit steps only for a specific day, mark steps as "Done", set routine reminders! :) Hope you enjoy the update!
